download_hf_model: download a HuggingFace model and tokenizer to a local directory using HF_AUTH_TOKEN
infer_cache_dir: infer the HuggingFace hub cache directory from the HF_HOME environment variable
infer_offline_model_dir: infer the offline model download directory from the HF_DOWNLOAD environment variable
infer_hf_device_memory: infer maximum GPU memory allocation per device in a model parallel group
run_download_model_cli: run the download_model function via Fire CLI to download a HuggingFace model
